title: A definition in the word's own form
statement: A definition gives the word's general meaning in the word's own grammatical form, without using the word itself or carrying over details from the text where it appears.
example: Two reviews found an adverb glossed as a verb phrase, a word-form error.
detail: An external audit found one word defined on every visible passage of a lesson as 'very fast and full of anger', with 'fast', it said, borrowed from the story rather than part of the word's meaning (`grade3-reading/artifacts/feedback-inceptbench-2026-09-30/REGISTER.md`). Two reviews found an adverb glossed as a verb phrase, a word-form error (`grade3-reading/artifacts/peter-pan-standing-2026-09-11/PP-STANDING.md`), and a review profile checks that a definition doesn't use the word it defines (`grade3-reading/artifacts/peter-pan-standing-2026-09-11/readiness-l5-2026-09-17/sim-review/agent-A-D1-D4.md`, D4.17).
against: The definition the audit faulted is the one the governing design prescribes, and it was put back to the design's wording until a ruling (`grade3-reading/artifacts/feedback-inceptbench-2026-09-30/REGISTER.md`). A later run found counter-evidence (`grade3-reading/artifacts/arc-audit/REGISTER-2026-09-15.md`).

**R-VOC-14b — a morpheme gloss is the morpheme's OWN meaning, not the target word's**: nurse glosses "to care for others" (not "someone who cares for young children" — that imports the target word's context into the part); -ry glosses "a place" (not "a place for it"). The gloss must survive transplanting the morpheme into a different word

Two independent reviewers confirmed that “triumphantly → won with great effort” is a definite word-form error.
That is a past-tense verb phrase, whereas the adverb describes a victorious manner.
Define the inflected sense naturally (for example, concealed = kept hidden), or deliberately retain a base-word reference in the definition.
The definition "when you are triumphant, you win a great victory after a hard struggle" is not an authoring error — it is the exact KB-sourced stamp specified in the design document.
